item.title: [6.4] India bonds continue rally ahead of inflation data
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bond yields extended their rally on Monday, with the benchmark 10-year yield falling nearly 4 basis points as easing crude oil prices and hopes of a US-Iran peace deal improved sentiment. Investors are now watching US and Indian inflation data for cues on the outlook for interest rates.

WHY IT MATTERS

The continuation of Indian bond rallies driven by falling oil prices and geopolitical hopes is a notable regional market move, though it remains tied to upcoming inflation data rather than a structural shift.

item.description:
